title: DFT relaxation of PtH at 113 GPa
action: Build the P6_3/mmc PtH crystal structure (Pt at Wyckoff 2c (1/3,2/3,1/4); H at 2a (0,0,0)) with initial lattice parameters a ≈ 2.70 Å, c ≈ 4.53 Å. Run a variable-cell relaxation in Quantum ESPRESSO (pw.x) at a target pressure of 113 GPa using the chosen pseudopotentials, until forces are below a typical threshold (e.g., 10^-2 eV/Å). Save the relaxed structure for the next stages.
description: Geometry optimization to obtain equilibrium lattice constants a and c under hydrostatic pressure.

title: Phonon and electron-phonon coupling calculation
action: Using the relaxed PtH structure from step_01_relax, compute dynamical matrices on a q-point grid via DFPT (ph.x). Then compute electron-phonon coupling matrix elements, Eliashberg spectral function, lambda, and omega_log using the QE stack.
description: Phonon dispersion and EPC calculation to obtain lambda and omega_log.

title: Extract results and compute Tc
action: From step_01_relax, extract the final lattice constants a and c (in Å). From step_02_epc, extract the EPC strength lambda and the logarithmic average phonon frequency omega_log (in K). Compute Tc using the Allen-Dynes modified McMillan formula with μ*=0.1. Write these five values to pth_results.json.
description: Final scored output file containing the reproduced lattice constants and superconducting Tc.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: a (float, Å), c (float, Å), lambda (float), omega_log (float, K), Tc (float, K)
